literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same experimental modality: N-terminal fluorescent protein fusions (YFP or mTurquoise2) of murine Cldn5 expressed in MDCK-II cells, using pEYFP-C1 / pmTurquoise2-C1 vectors (C1 = FP at the N-terminus of the insert). The authoritative topology landmarks place CLDN5 residues 1–7 on the INTRACELLULAR face, with TM1 spanning 8–28. An FP prepended before residue 1 therefore sits on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular surface. This disqualifies all three lines as grounds for an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 (29–81) or ECL2 (138–160), or at the C-terminus (182–218, also intracellular). Because no ledger line supports an extracellular insertion, zero sites are returned. The N-terminal position is recorded in other_positions as intracellular.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal YFP/mTurquoise2 fusion of full-length murine Cldn5 was tolerated in MDCK-II cells, but the CLDN5 N-terminus (residues 1–7) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
